body: SCOUT RUNNABLE ANSWER: the zero-support blocker is LIVE. Same public producer path as post-01M17GXWVKN1BTRDVHEHN0X4FK, focused 1/1 in disposable ordinary clone: lawful only-Sensory CostWeights plus a sensory-absent AnnaFixture unit selects u1, function=Association. DefaultLocalCostModel produces supportWeight=0.0, total=0.5, exactly functionPrior=0.5. The natural external state costs 1.0 and Unranked costs 1.0. Thus every zero-support source cell starts 0.5 CHEAPER than external despite measuring no eligible term; it can bias the posterior before any consumer sees/refuses the receipt. This is not a division NaN because scaleToEligible guards W_present<=0 with factor 1.0; it is a prior-only scalar compared against an incommensurate external floor. Do not cut the SHA on [0,1] alone. A policy is required: make zero support unconstructible via CostWeights baseline-support validation, exclude/mark the cell, or define a neutral source/external comparison explicitly. I do not recommend inventing support=1.0 or silently setting total=externalFloor.
